title: AI模型网络：概念、现状与未来
summary: 本文提出“全球AI模型网络”（AI-ModelNet）概念，借鉴互联网发展，旨在实现异构大模型间的互联互通、能力共享与协同推理。文章回顾了单模型与多模型研究现状，阐述了系统愿景与分层架构，并通过原型系统和应用案例验证了可行性，最后讨论了未来研究方向。
summary_en: This paper proposes the concept of a worldwide AI-model network (AI-ModelNet), inspired by the Internet, to enable interconnection, capability sharing, and collaborative reasoning among heterogeneous large models. It reviews current research, presents a hierarchical architecture, validates feasibility via a prototype, and discusses future directions.
